summary: MediaAlpha filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, disclosing an Assignment, Assumption and Termination Agreement with Parallaxes Mars entities (PLX) to buy back PLX's interest in its Tax Receivables Agreement for $12.0 million cash, a 47% discount ($10.7 million) to the $22.7 million estimated June 30, 2026 value of that interest. The board, majority independent and disinterested, approved under related-person procedures. Post-transaction TRA liability is about $32 million; the deal is not a change of control or early termination. Funded from subsidiary cash via a pro rata QLH distribution to members, including executives. Watch related-party optics and remaining counterparty payments.
